Asha is an android of the UFS.



Personality
She talks in a monotone voice and doesn't show any emotions. Asha is able to feel emotions like lust and fear but is not used to them.

Appearance
She has white hair and blue eyes with purple elements.

History
Background
Asha was originally a combat android prototype of the UFS also called Anastasia.

This weapon was made by a perverted UFS scientist, explaining her look and the fact she contains some organic components. She later was stolen by the Mafia and has since worked for them as a bodyguard. Although she looks like just a girl, she boasts high combat capabilities. Her bio-functions have been reproduced almost exactly like a person's, and it is impossible to recognize her at first glance. She is feared by rival organizations because of the way she uses her appearance to eliminate unwary opponents in an unobtrusive manner. Her true identity is that of a prototype "annihilation weapon" sent by the UFS coalition to illegally collect battle data. The mafia is naturally unaware of this, and Asha herself has only been given the task of sending the data and the code, "Damocles Project". She has been killing people in accordance with her program, but as she watches them die, she begins to question what death means to her as an android. Asha begins to consider the difference between herself and others, and questions the meaning of her own existence. The question steadily grows as she kills more and more people. She needs the same food as humans for the maintenance of her biological parts and as her main energy source, but she devours unprocessed foodstuffs, which is why the mafia are attracted to her.

Timeline TABA
In her "what if" event, Fuuma Kotaro (TABA)'s Fuuma Organization was in conflict with the mafia that Asha protected. Before he could kill the ringleader, Asha allowed his enemy to escape, but Kotaro captured Asha. Using his skills, he "convinced" her to join.


Powers/Abilities
Main Weapon: Knife and Scorpion Tail

Close Combat Expert
Scorpion Tail: A CQC weapon, which can move freely on the red wire, it helps to attack targets out of her sight.
Minor healing: Contains some organic components which can heal.
Media
Taimanin Asagi Battle Arena
Trivia
Taimanin Asagi Battle Arena officially translated her name as Asha, but some websites still call her Ayesha based on fan translation.
The name "Damocles" suggests that her goal will be to destroy the mafia in the end. The idea of the sword of Damocles being a blade, which is waiting to drop at an unknown point in time and kill, causing great anguish until that point arrives.
Additional information is given in TABA Artbook 10.
